question_mn: Олголт хүлээж буй зээл хэд байна, нийт дүн нь төгрөгөөр хэд вэ?
question_latin: Olgolt hvleej bui zeel hed baina, niit dvn ni tugruguur hed we?
question_en: How many loans are awaiting disbursement, and what is their total amount in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_amount_mnt) AS principal_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE status_code = 'PENDING_DISBURSEMENT'

question_mn: Багцад хамгийн удаан хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээлийн дугаар, хэтэрсэн хоногийг хэл
question_latin: Bagtsad khamgiin udaan khugatsaa khetersen zeeliin dugaar, khetersen khonogiig khel
question_en: Give the loan number and days past due of the most delinquent loan in the portfolio.
gold_sql: SELECT loan_number, days_past_due FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio ORDER BY days_past_due DESC, loan_id LIMIT 1

question_mn: Хугацааны эцэст нэг дор төлөгдөх нөхцөлтэй хэдэн зээл багцад байна?
question_latin: hugatsaanii etsest neg dor tulugduh nuhtsultei heden zeel bagtsad baina?
question_en: How many loans in the portfolio are repaid in a single bullet payment at maturity?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND amortization_type = 'BULLET'

question_mn: Ам.долларын идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт хэдэн доллар вэ?
question_latin: Am.dollariin idevkhtei zeeluudiin undsen uldegdel niit kheden dollar ve?
question_en: What is the total outstanding principal of active USD loans, in dollars?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(principal_outstanding) AS principal_outstanding_usd FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND currency_code = 'USD'

question_mn: Чанаргүй зээл хэд байна?
question_latin: Chanargvi zeel hed bn
question_en: How many non-performing loans are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS npl_loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND is_npl

question_mn: Энэ онд бүрэн төлөгдөж хаагдсан зээл хэд вэ?
question_latin: Ene ond bvren tulugduj haagdsan zeel hed we
question_en: How many loans have been fully repaid and closed this year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE status_code = 'CLOSED' AND closed_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'

question_mn: Төгрөгийн идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн торгуулийн үлдэгдэл нийт хэд вэ?
question_latin: togrogiin idevkhtei zeeluudiin torguuliin uldegdel niit khed ve?
question_en: What is the total outstanding penalty on active MNT loans?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(penalty_outstanding) AS penalty_outstanding FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND currency_code = 'MNT'

question_mn: Өнөөдөр хэдэн зээл олгосон бэ?
question_latin: Unuudur heden zeel olgoson be?
question_en: How many loans were disbursed today?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date = CURRENT_DATE

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багц дахь хамгийн том зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл төгрөгөөр хэд вэ?
question_latin: Idevkhtei bagts dakhi khamgiin tom zeeliin undsen uldegdel togrogoor khed ve?
question_en: What is the largest outstanding principal of a single loan in the active portfolio, in MNT?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS max_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Олгосон дүнгийнхээ талаас илүүг аль хэдийн төлж барагдуулсан идэвхтэй зээл хэд байна?
question_latin: Olgoson dvngiinhee talaas ilvvg ali hediin tulj baragduulsan idewhtei zeel hed baina?
question_en: How many active loans have already repaid more than half of the disbursed amount?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND principal_paid > 0.5 * disbursed_amount

question_mn: Зээлийн бүтээгдэхүүн тус бүрийн чанаргүй зээлийн хувь болон шаардлагатай эрсдэлийн сангийн хэмжээг гарга
question_latin: zeeliin bvteegdehvvn tus bvriin chanargvi zeeliin huwi bolon shaardlagatai ersdeliin sangiin hemjeeg garga
question_en: Show the NPL ratio and the required loan loss provision for each loan product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS npl_ratio, ROUND(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt * l.provision_rate / 100), 2) AS required_provision FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY p.product_name

question_mn: KYC нь баталгаажаагүй хэрнээ идэвхтэй багцад зээлтэй харилцагч хэд байна, тэдний зээлийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт хэд вэ?
question_latin: KYC ni batalgaajaagui khernee idevkhtei bagtsad zeeltei khariltsagch khed baina, tednii zeeliin undsen uldegdel niit khed ve?
question_en: How many customers whose KYC is not verified still have loans in the active portfolio, and what is their total outstanding principal?
question_mixed: KYC verified биш хэрнээ active portfolio-д зээлтэй customer хэд, тэдний outstanding principal хэд вэ?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS customers, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND c.kyc_status <> 'VERIFIED'

question_mn: Валют бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг өөрийн валютаар болон төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: Walyut bvreer idewhtei zeeliin too, vndsen vldegdliig uuriin walyutaar bolon tugruguur garga
question_en: By currency, show the number of active loans and the outstanding principal both in the original currency and in MNT.
gold_sql: SELECT currency_code, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding) AS principal_outstanding, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY currency_code

question_mn: 2025 онд олгосон зээлүүдийн нэг зээлийн дундаж хэмжээг төгрөгөөр бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр гарга
question_latin: 2025 ond olgoson zeeluudiin neg zeeliin dundaj khemjeeg togrogoor buteegdekhuunii torol bureer garga
question_en: Show the average size per loan, in MNT, of loans disbursed in 2025, by product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, ROUND(AVG(l.principal_amount_mnt), 2) AS avg_loan_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн нийт үлдэгдэл (хүү, торгууль, шимтгэл орсон) үндсэн үлдэгдлээсээ хэдэн хувиар их байгааг гарга
question_latin: salbar bvreer idewhtei zeeliin niit vldegdel (hvv, torguuli, shimtgel orson) vndsen vldegdleesee heden huwiar ih baigaag garga
question_en: For each branch, by what percentage does the total outstanding of active loans (including interest, penalties and fees) exceed the outstanding principal?
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(l.total_outstanding_mnt) - SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt)) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS excess_over_principal_pct FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name
notes: нийт үлдэгдэлд ирээдүйн хуваарийн хүү орно

question_mn: Эргэн төлөлтийн арга бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдэл болон PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: Ergen tulultiin arga bvreer idewhtei zeeliin too, vndsen vldegdel bolon PAR30-iig garga
question_en: For each repayment (amortization) method, show the number of active loans, the outstanding principal and the PAR30.
gold_sql: SELECT amortization_type, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY amortization_type

question_mn: Өндөр хүүтэй зээл илүү эрсдэлтэй юу? Идэвхтэй зээлүүдийг жилийн хүүгээр нь 20 хүртэл, 20–30, 30–40, 40 ба түүнээс дээш хувь гэж ангилаад, ангилал бүрийн зээлийн тоо болон PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: Ondor khuutei zeel iluu ersdeltei yuu? Idevkhtei zeeluudiig jiliin khuugeer ni 20 khurtel, 20-30, 30-40, 40 ba tuunees deesh khuvi gej angilaad, angilal buriin zeeliin too bolon PAR30-iig garga
question_en: Are higher-rate loans riskier? Classify active loans by annual interest rate (under 20, 20-30, 30-40, 40 percent and above) and show the number of loans and the PAR30 in each class.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN interest_rate < 20 THEN '20 хүртэл' WHEN interest_rate < 30 THEN '20-30' WHEN interest_rate < 40 THEN '30-40' ELSE '40+' END AS rate_band, COUNT(*) AS loans, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцад 50-аас олон зээл хариуцаж байгаа зээлийн мэргэжилтнүүдийн нэр, зээлийн тоог гарга
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsad 50-aas olon zeel hariutsaj baigaa zeeliin mergejiltnvvdiin ner, zeeliin toog garga
question_en: Show the names and loan counts of loan officers who manage more than 50 loans in the active portfolio.
gold_sql: SELECT e.full_name, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.employees e ON e.employee_id = l.loan_officer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.full_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 50

question_mn: Зээлдэгчийн оршин суугаа аймаг, хот бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлтэй харилцагчийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: zeeldegchiin orshin suugaa aimag, khot bureer idevkhtei zeeltei khariltsagchiin too, undsen uldegdliig garga
question_en: By the borrower's province or city of residence, show the number of customers with active loans and the outstanding principal.
gold_sql: SELECT c.province, COUNT(DISTINCT l.customer_id) AS borrowers, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY c.province

question_mn: Сүүлийн 3 сард (4, 5, 6-р сар) бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр хэдэн зээл, ямар дүнгээр олгосныг гарга
question_latin: Svvliin 3 sard (4, 5, 6-r sar) bvteegdehvvnii turul bvreer heden zeel, yamar dvngeer olgosniig garga
question_en: Over the last 3 months (April, May, June), show how many loans were disbursed and for what amount, by product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) AS disbursed_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: 2026 оны 7–12-р сард сар бүр эцсийн төлөлтийн хугацаа нь болох идэвхтэй зээлийн тоо, үндсэн үлдэгдлийг гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 7-12-r sard sar bvr etssiin tulultiin hugatsaa ni boloh idewhtei zeeliin too, vndsen vldegdliig garga
question_en: For each month from July to December 2026, show the number of active loans reaching final maturity and their outstanding principal.
question_mixed: 2026 оны 7–12-р сард month бүр maturity нь болох active зээлийн тоо, outstanding-ийг гарга
gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', maturity_date)::date AS month, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND maturity_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Идэвхтэй зээлүүдийг хугацаагаар нь 12 сар хүртэл, 13–36 сар, 37–60 сар, 60-аас дээш сар гэж ангилж, ангилал бүрийн зээлийн тоо болон үлдэгдлээр жигнэсэн дундаж хүүг гарга
question_latin: Idevkhtei zeeluudiig khugatsaagaar ni 12 sar khurtel, 13-36 sar, 37-60 sar, 60-aas deesh sar gej angilj, angilal buriin zeeliin too bolon uldegdleer jignesen dundaj khuug garga
question_en: Classify active loans by term (up to 12 months, 13-36, 37-60, over 60 months) and show the number of loans and the outstanding-weighted average interest rate for each class.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN term_months <= 12 THEN '12 сар хүртэл' WHEN term_months <= 36 THEN '13-36 сар' WHEN term_months <= 60 THEN '37-60 сар' ELSE '60-аас дээш' END AS term_band, COUNT(*) AS loans, ROUND(SUM(interest_rate * principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS weighted_rate FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Тэтгэвэр авагч зээлдэгчдийн PAR30-ийг бусад хувь хүн зээлдэгчдийнхтэй харьцуулж гарга
question_latin: tetgewer awagch zeeldegchdiin PAR30-iig busad huwi hvn zeeldegchdiinhtei haritsuulj garga
question_en: Compare the PAR30 of pensioner borrowers with that of other individual borrowers.
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.customer_type_code = 'IND_PENSION' THEN 'Тэтгэвэр авагч' ELSE 'Бусад хувь хүн' END AS borrower_group, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND c.party_type = 'INDIVIDUAL' GROUP BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлийн торгуулийн үлдэгдлийг төгрөгөөр гарга
question_latin: Salbar bureer idevkhtei zeeliin torguuliin uldegdliig togrogoor garga
question_en: Show the outstanding penalty of active loans in MNT for each branch.
question_mixed: Branch бүрээр active зээлийн penalty үлдэгдлийг MNT-ээр гарга
gold_sql: SELECT b.branch_name, ROUND(SUM(l.penalty_outstanding * l.fx_rate_to_mnt), 2) AS penalty_outstanding_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY b.branch_name

question_mn: Сүүлийн төлөлт хийснээс хойш 60-аас олон хоног өнгөрсөн идэвхтэй зээл хэд байна? Огт төлөлт хийгээгүй зээлийг тооцохгүй.
question_latin: Svvliin tulult hiisnees hoish 60-aas olon honog ungursun idewhtei zeel hed baina? Ogt tulult hiigeegvi zeeliig tootsohgvi.
question_en: How many active loans have gone more than 60 days since their last payment? Exclude loans that have never made a payment.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio AND last_payment_date IS NOT NULL AND last_payment_date < CURRENT_DATE - 60

question_mn: Идэвхтэй барьцааных нь LTV 70%-иас давсан идэвхтэй зээл хэд байна?
question_latin: Idewhtei baritsaaniih ni LTV 70%-ias dawsan idewhtei zeel hed baina?
question_en: How many active loans have an active collateral link with an LTV above 70%?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.loan_collaterals lc ON lc.loan_id = l.loan_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND lc.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lc.ltv_ratio > 70
notes: нэг зээл олон барьцаатай байж болох тул DISTINCT

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр хэвийн, хяналтад, чанар муудсан болон чанаргүй ангиллын үндсэн үлдэгдлийг тус тусад нь гарга. Үлдэгдэлгүй ангилалд 0 гэж харуул.
question_latin: buteegdekhuunii torol bureer kheviin, khyanaltad, chanar muudsan bolon chanargui angilliin undsen uldegdliig tus tusad ni garga. Uldegdelgui angilald 0 gej kharuul.
question_en: By product type, show the outstanding principal in the normal, watch, substandard and non-performing classes separately; show 0 where a class has no balance.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.classification_code = 'NORMAL'), 0) AS normal_mnt, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.classification_code = 'WATCH'), 0) AS watch_mnt, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.classification_code = 'SUBSTANDARD'), 0) AS substandard_mnt, COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) AS npl_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцын эцсийн хугацаа хүртэл үлдсэн хоногийг үндсэн үлдэгдлээр жигнэсэн дунджийг гарга. Хугацаа нь аль хэдийн өнгөрсөн зээлийг 0 гэж тооцно.
question_latin: Idewhtei bagtsiin etssiin hugatsaa hvrtel vldsen honogiig vndsen vldegdleer jignesen dundjiig garga. Hugatsaa ni ali hediin ungursun zeeliig 0 gej tootsno.
question_en: Calculate the outstanding-weighted average number of days remaining to maturity for the active portfolio, counting already-matured loans as 0.
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(GREATEST(maturity_date - CURRENT_DATE, 0) * principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS weighted_remaining_days FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio

question_mn: Олгосон он бүрээр идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн анх олгосон дүнгийн хэдэн хувь нь үндсэн үлдэгдэл хэлбэрээр төлөгдөөгүй байна вэ?
question_latin: Olgoson on bureer idevkhtei zeeluudiin ankh olgoson dungiin kheden khuvi ni undsen uldegdel khelbereer tologdoogui bn ve
question_en: By disbursement year, what percentage of the originally disbursed amount of active loans is still outstanding as principal?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM disbursement_date)::int AS disbursement_year, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_amount_mnt), 0), 2) AS outstanding_pct FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question_mn: Салбар бүрээр 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцсийн агшинд бүртгэлтэй байсан идэвхтэй зээлийн тоог одоогийн идэвхтэй зээлийн тоотой харьцуулж, өсөлтийн хувийг гарга
question_latin: Salbar bvreer 2025 onii 12-r sariin etssiin agshind bvrtgeltei baisan idewhtei zeeliin toog odoogiin idewhtei zeeliin tootoi haritsuulj, usultiin huwiig garga
question_en: For each branch, compare the number of active loans in the end-of-December-2025 snapshot with the current number of active loans and show the growth percentage.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT l.branch_id, COUNT(*) AS loans_2025_12 FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = '2025-12-31' GROUP BY l.branch_id), n AS (SELECT branch_id, COUNT(*) AS loans_now FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY branch_id) SELECT b.branch_name, s.loans_2025_12, n.loans_now, ROUND(100.0 * (n.loans_now - s.loans_2025_12) / NULLIF(s.loans_2025_12, 0), 2) AS growth_pct FROM n JOIN s ON s.branch_id = n.branch_id JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = n.branch_id
notes: сарын эцсийн агшинд зөвхөн идэвхтэй зээл бичигддэг

question_mn: Идэвхтэй багцад 2 ба түүнээс олон зээлтэй зээлдэгч хэд байна, тэдний үндсэн үлдэгдэл нийт багцын хэдэн хувийг эзэлж байна?
question_latin: idewhtei bagtsad 2 ba tvvnees olon zeeltei zeeldegch hed baina, tednii vndsen vldegdel niit bagtsiin heden huwiig ezelj baina?
question_en: How many borrowers have two or more loans in the active portfolio, and what share of the total portfolio principal do they hold?
gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS loans, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS outstanding FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE loans >= 2) AS multi_loan_borrowers, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(outstanding) FILTER (WHERE loans >= 2) / SUM(outstanding), 2) AS share_pct FROM b

question_mn: 2026 оны 3-р сарын эцсээс 6-р сарын эцсийн агшин хүртэл зээлүүд активын ангиллын хооронд хэрхэн шилжсэнийг өмнөх ангилал, шинэ ангилал, зээлийн тоогоор гарга
question_latin: 2026 onii 3-r sariin etssees 6-r sariin etssiin agshin khurtel zeeluud aktiviin angilliin khoorond kherkhen shiljseniig omnokh angilal, shine angilal, zeeliin toogoor garga
question_en: Show how loans migrated between asset classifications from the end-of-March 2026 snapshot to the end-of-June 2026 snapshot: previous class, new class and number of loans.
gold_sql: SELECT a.classification_code AS class_2026_03, b.classification_code AS class_2026_06, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history a JOIN t2s.loan_dpd_history b ON b.loan_id = a.loan_id AND b.snapshot_date = '2026-06-30' WHERE a.snapshot_date = '2026-03-31' GROUP BY a.classification_code, b.classification_code
notes: хоёр агшинд хоёуланд нь байгаа зээлүүд

question_mn: 2025 оны 1-р улирлаас 2026 оны 2-р улирал хүртэл улирал бүрийн зээл олголтын дүн (төгрөгөөр) болон өмнөх улирлаас хэдэн хувиар өссөнийг гарга
question_latin: 2025 onii 1-r ulirlaas 2026 onii 2-r uliral hvrtel uliral bvriin zeel olgoltiin dvn (tugruguur) bolon umnuh ulirlaas heden huwiar ussuniig garga
question_en: From Q1 2025 to Q2 2026, show the loan disbursement amount (in MNT) for each quarter and its growth percentage from the previous quarter.
question_mixed: 2025 Q1-ээс 2026 Q2 хүртэл quarter бүрийн disbursement дүн болон QoQ growth %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH q AS (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', disbursement_date)::date AS quarter_start, SUM(principal_amount_mnt) AS disbursed_mnt FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1), g AS (SELECT quarter_start, disbursed_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * (disbursed_mnt - LAG(disbursed_mnt) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start)) / NULLIF(LAG(disbursed_mnt) OVER (ORDER BY quarter_start), 0), 2) AS qoq_growth_pct FROM q) SELECT quarter_start, disbursed_mnt, qoq_growth_pct FROM g WHERE quarter_start >= '2025-01-01' ORDER BY quarter_start

question_mn: Бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр энэ оны эхний хагаст олгосон зээлийн олгосон дүнгээр жигнэсэн дундаж хүүг өнгөрсөн оны мөн үеийнхтэй харьцуулж, өөрчлөлтийг нэгж хувиар гарга
question_latin: Buteegdekhuunii torol bureer ene onii ekhnii khagast olgoson zeeliin olgoson dungeer jignesen dundaj khuug ongorson onii mon ueiinkhtei kharitsuulj, oorchloltiig negj khuviar garga
question_en: By product type, compare the disbursement-weighted average interest rate of loans disbursed in the first half of this year with the same period last year, and show the change in percentage points.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.product_type_name, SUM(l.interest_rate * l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30') / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30'), 0) AS rate_h1_2025, SUM(l.interest_rate * l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30') / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30'), 0) AS rate_h1_2026 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' OR l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY p.product_type_name) SELECT product_type_name, ROUND(rate_h1_2025, 2) AS rate_h1_2025, ROUND(rate_h1_2026, 2) AS rate_h1_2026, ROUND(rate_h1_2026 - rate_h1_2025, 2) AS change_pp FROM r

question_mn: PAR30 нь нийт багцын PAR30-аас өндөр байгаа салбаруудын нэр, PAR30-ийг гарга
question_latin: PAR30 ni niit bagtsiin PAR30-aas undur baigaa salbaruudiin ner, PAR30-iig garga
question_en: Show the names and PAR30 of branches whose PAR30 is higher than the PAR30 of the whole portfolio.
gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT br.branch_name, 100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) AS par30 FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches br ON br.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio GROUP BY br.branch_name) SELECT branch_name, ROUND(par30, 2) AS par30 FROM b WHERE par30 > (SELECT 100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE days_past_due > 30), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt), 0) FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio)

question_mn: Хамгийн сүүлийн зээлээ 2024 онд авсан, одоо идэвхтэй зээлгүй байгаа харилцагч хэд вэ?
question_latin: Hamgiin svvliin zeelee 2024 ond awsan, odoo idewhtei zeelgvi baigaa hariltsagch hed we?
question_en: How many customers took their most recent loan in 2024 and currently have no active loan?
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(disbursement_date) AS last_disbursement FROM t2s.loans WHERE disbursement_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers FROM c WHERE c.last_disbursement BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans l WHERE l.customer_id = c.customer_id AND l.is_active_portfolio)

question_mn: Идэвхтэй зээлийн нийт үндсэн үлдэгдэл нь сарын орлогоосоо 20 дахин их байгаа хувь хүн зээлдэгч хэд байна?
question_latin: Idevkhtei zeeliin niit undsen uldegdel ni sariin orlogoosoo 20 dakhin ikh baigaa khuvi khun zeeldegch khed baina?
question_en: How many individual borrowers have a total active outstanding principal greater than 20 times their monthly income?
gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(principal_outstanding_mnt) AS debt FROM t2s.loans WHERE is_active_portfolio GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS borrowers FROM d JOIN t2s.individuals i ON i.customer_id = d.customer_id WHERE d.debt > 20 * i.monthly_income

question_mn: 2025 оны 12-р сарын эцсийн агшинд хугацаа хэтэрсэн байсан зээлүүд өнөөдөр ямар төлөвтэй байгааг төлөв бүрээр тоолж гарга
question_latin: 2025 onii 12-r sariin etssiin agshind hugatsaa hetersen baisan zeelvvd unuudur yamar tuluwtei baigaag tuluw bvreer toolj garga
question_en: For loans that were past due in the end-of-December-2025 snapshot, count them by their current loan status.
gold_sql: SELECT l.status_name, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM t2s.loan_dpd_history h JOIN t2s.loans l ON l.loan_id = h.loan_id WHERE h.snapshot_date = '2025-12-31' AND h.days_past_due > 0 GROUP BY l.status_name
notes: агшин дахь хугацаа хэтрэлт = тухайн өдрийн DPD > 0

question_mn: Орон нутгийн салбаруудаас ЖДҮ-д олгосон идэвхтэй зээлүүдийн үндсэн үлдэгдэл болон NPL хувийг бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүрээр гарга
question_latin: oron nutgiin salbaruudaas JDU-d olgoson idevkhtei zeeluudiin undsen uldegdel bolon NPL khuviig buteegdekhuunii torol bureer garga
question_en: For active loans granted to SMEs by rural branches, show the outstanding principal and the NPL ratio by product type.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_type_name, SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) AS principal_outstanding_mnt, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt) FILTER (WHERE l.is_npl), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(l.principal_outstanding_mnt), 0), 2) AS npl_ratio FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.branches b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id JOIN t2s.customers c ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.is_active_portfolio AND b.province <> 'Улаанбаатар' AND c.customer_type_code = 'ORG_SME' GROUP BY p.product_type_name

question_mn: Энэ улирлын сар бүрийн зээл олголтын дүнд бүтээгдэхүүний төрөл бүр хэдэн хувийг эзэлсэн бэ?
question_latin: Ene ulirliin sar bvriin zeel olgoltiin dvnd bvteegdehvvnii turul bvr heden huwiig ezelsen be?
question_en: For each month of this quarter, what percentage of the disbursed amount did each product type account for?
question_mixed: Энэ quarter-ийн month бүрийн disbursement дүнд product type бүрийн share %-ийг гарга
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', l.disbursement_date)::date AS month, p.product_type_name, SUM(l.principal_amount_mnt) AS disbursed_mnt FROM t2s.loans l JOIN t2s.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE l.disbursement_date BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-06-30' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT month, product_type_name, ROUND(100.0 * disbursed_mnt / SUM(disbursed_mnt) OVER (PARTITION BY month), 2) AS share_pct FROM m ORDER BY month, share_pct DESC

question_mn: Хугацаа хэтэрсэн зээлтэй хэрнээ өөр нэг хугацаа хэтрээгүй идэвхтэй зээлтэй зээлдэгч хэд байна?
question_latin: Hugatsaa hetersen zeeltei hernee uur neg hugatsaa hetreegvi idewhtei zeeltei zeeldegch hed bn
question_en: How many borrowers have an overdue loan while also having another active loan that is not overdue?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers FROM t2s.loans o WHERE o.is_active_portfolio AND o.days_past_due > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t2s.loans n WHERE n.customer_id = o.customer_id AND n.loan_id <> o.loan_id AND n.is_active_portfolio AND n.days_past_due = 0)
